topic: Spring Framework Fundamentals and Dependency Injection
learningObjectives: Explain inversion of control and dependency injection.
Identify common Spring components and their responsibilities.
Construct a basic dependency-injection flow using Spring-managed components.

activities.title: Spring Core Concepts
activities.instruction: Explore the major concepts behind Spring dependency management.

content.concept: Spring's IoC container manages application objects and can inject their dependencies instead of requiring each class to construct those dependencies itself.

activities.title: Dependency Injection Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange how a Spring-managed dependency is provided.

content.concept: A Spring application defines components and their dependencies, the container creates the required objects, and the dependency is supplied when the dependent component is created.
